fact_sheet_status.notes: Excel Col H blank, but matching public folder found in Drive master folder

min_gpa_host.notes: No minimum incoming study abroad/exchange GPA is stated in the 2026-27 Study Abroad Factsheet or 2024-25 VS Factsheet.

instruction_languages.notes: London-based US/UK dual-accredited university operating in English.

english_course_availability.notes: Full curriculum delivered in English (500+ courses in 2022 Guide; Fall 2026 Course List PDF).

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Required for non-native speakers per https://www.richmond.ac.uk/undergraduate-admissions/: IELTS Academic 5.5 (min 5.5 all 4 components), TOEFL iBT 72 (17L/18R/17W/20S), PTE Academic 51 (51 all components), Oxford ELLT B2 in all 4 components, or Cambridge Scale min 168 per skill (2024-25 Factsheet p.2). RHET 1020 waiver not explicitly mentioned.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.notes: 2026-27 Factsheet links https://www.richmond.ac.uk/undergraduate-admissions/; also matches data/raw/factsheets/Richmond American University, London/2022/study-abroad-visiting-students-2022-web.pdf#page=16.

host_language_requirement.value: English (CEFR B2 equivalent scores required for non-native English speakers).
host_language_requirement.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Richmond University/2024-2025/International Programmes VS Factsheet - Maggie Burton.pdf#page=2

fall_term_dates.value: Fall 2026: Orientation Sep 1-6, 2026; Classes Sep 7 - Dec 11, 2026 (Tutorial Week Oct 26 - Nov 1, no classes); Exams Dec 14-18, 2026.

spring_term_dates.value: Spring 2027: Orientation Jan 11-17, 2027; Classes Jan 18 - Apr 23, 2027 (Tutorial Week Mar 8-14, no classes); Exams Apr 26 - May 2, 2027.

tuition_model.notes: 2026-27 Study Abroad Factsheet explicitly lists Tuition: GBP 6,300/semester (GBP 5,355/semester with partner discount). Earlier 2024-25 factsheet (data/raw/factsheets/Richmond University/2024-2025/International Programmes VS Factsheet - Maggie Burton.pdf#page=3) stated 'as soon as we receive payment (if applicable)' and richmond.ac.uk notes partner-specific fee agreements/waivers vary.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: RAUL does not publish a full official monthly GBP living-cost budget range (accommodation-only rates at Stay Club North Acton are published separately at https://www.richmond.ac.uk/LONDON-Student-Accommodation-for-Fall-2026-Spring-2027; UKVI visa maintenance threshold is not a living-cost guide).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: Omitted because RAUL does not publish a comprehensive monthly local living-cost estimate.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: 2026-27 Study Abroad tuition is GBP 6,300/semester (GBP 5,355/semester with partner discount); healthcare coverage guidance is linked inside the Study Abroad factsheet.

housing_availability.notes: 2026-27 Factsheet guarantees beds if applied by early housing deadline (Jun 1 Fall / Oct 11 Spring); first-come, first-served thereafter.

housing_notes.value: Partnered accommodation at The Stay Club North Acton (private en-suite single studios with kitchenettes, utilities, Wi-Fi, RA/RD support, optional meal plan). 2026-27 visitor rates incl. council tax: GBP 445/week (1-term, 16-week contract) or GBP 414/week (2-term, 35-week contract), plus GBP 250 deposit. Guarantee deadline Jun 1 (Fall) / Oct 11 (Spring).
housing_notes.notes: Facility & RA/RD details in data/raw/factsheets/Richmond University/2026-2027/Richmond Factsheet - STUDY ABROAD.docx.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Single-semester (<6 months) students enter as Standard Visitors and must obtain a UK Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) before travel (or apply prior if visa-national). Stays >6 months require a UK Student Visa (no ETA needed; English proof requirements apply).

exchange_page_url.notes: Study Abroad policy and accommodation details hosted on richmond.ac.uk (https://www.richmond.ac.uk/LONDON-Student-Accommodation-for-Fall-2026-Spring-2027).

course_catalog_url.notes: Course listings distributed via term PDF (Fall 2026 Course List PDF in Drive) and RAUL Course Specification pages on richmond.ac.uk.

english_course_list_url.notes: All courses are taught in English; see Fall 2026 Course List.pdf in partner Drive folder.

credit_system_and_load.value: US credit system: all Study Abroad classes at RAUL are 4 US credits each.

course_restrictions_note.value: Academic advisors verify prerequisites ahead of registration; students are advised to have 4 backup courses pre-approved for Add/Drop adjustments.

value: Home university nomination (sent to International Programmes team)
Scanned copies of all academic transcripts (in English)
Scanned English proficiency scores (for non-native speakers)
Colour scan of passport photo page
required_application_docs.notes: 2026-27 Factsheet explicitly notes academic reference and personal statement are NOT required.

academic_style.value: Dual US (Middle States) and UK (Taught Degree Awarding Powers) liberal arts university featuring small classes, US credit transferability, Tutorial Weeks, and optional 4-credit London internships.
academic_style.notes: Dual accreditation & 4-credit internship on p.4 & p.15; Tutorial Week in data/raw/factsheets/Richmond University/2026-2027/Richmond Factsheet - STUDY ABROAD.docx.

city_tier.notes: Excel lists city 'Richmond'; physical campus relocated to Chiswick Park (London W4 5AN). Omitted without unambiguous schema classification.

campus_type.notes: Located in Chiswick Business Park, West London (mixed landscaped business park / urban transport setting); omitted to avoid urban/suburban ambiguity.

international_support_services.value: International Programmes advising team (pre-arrival Teams course advising), Stay Club Resident Assistants/Resident Directors (RA/RD), Student Affairs wellbeing support (TalkCampus).

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall 2026: Nomination May 15, Application Jun 1 (Housing guarantee Jun 1). Spring 2027: Nomination Oct 15, Application Nov 1 (Housing guarantee Oct 11).
